issues.impact: The printed rate does not imply the fast-loop near-optimality explicitly asserted in the proposed two-timescale regret framework. Bounded persistent suboptimality satisfies it automatically. The separate slow-loop trend definition is not rendered vacuous.
issues.core_dependency: Core dependency: Section 4.1 introduces the two-timescale regret framework and explicitly uses the fast-loop rate as the condition for reaching near-optimality within the current perception. For bounded persistent suboptimality the printed condition is automatically satisfied, so that optimization conclusion does not follow. This is a demonstrated failure of a formal implication attached to the proposed measurement framework, supporting Major independently of the Section 3 theorem failures. Definition 4.1's trend criterion and the general case for adaptation can survive. Replacing the rate is a narrow repair; its ease does not reduce the severity of the failed implication.
